login.heading: Sign in to continue to {app}
login.intro: {app} uses your YourTal account to sign you in.

create.heading: Create an account to continue to {app}
create.intro: {app} uses your YourTal account to sign you in.

verify.heading: Check your email
verify.intro: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm it's yours, then you'll go on to {app}.
verify.resendPrompt: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or ask for another.
verify.resent: We've sent a new link to {email}.
verify.resendThrottled: You asked a moment ago. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
verify.resendFailed: We couldn't send it. Try again shortly.

signInAgain.heading: Sign in again to continue to {app}
signInAgain.intro: {app} asks you to sign in to YourTal again to confirm it's you.

consent.heading: Continue to {app} as {name}
consent.shareRegionAU: that your YourTal account is for Australia
consent.shareRegionID: that your YourTal account is for Indonesia
consent.wontGet: It won't get your date of birth, your password or your points.
consent.runByExternal: {app} is run by {operator}, not by YourTal.
consent.policyAfterClause: Its privacy policy explains how it uses your details.
consent.policyAlone: Its privacy policy explains how it uses your details.
consent.linkedApps: You can remove {app} at any time in YourTal, under Me → Linked apps.

teenConsent.heading: Join {app} with {parent}'s invite
teenConsent.invited: {parent} invited you to use {app} to keep track of your spending.
teenConsent.parentSees: {parent} can see everything you add to {app}: receipts, amounts and notes.
teenConsent.getsAU: {app} will get your name and email address, that you're under 18, and that your YourTal account is for Australia.
teenConsent.getsID: {app} will get your name and email address, that you're under 18, and that your YourTal account is for Indonesia.
teenConsent.noPoints: You won't earn YourTal points for receipts.
teenConsent.parentEnds: {parent} can end your access at any time. If they do, your {app} data is deleted.

account_on_hold.title: Your YourTal account is on hold
account_on_hold.body: You can't use it to sign in to other apps right now. Contact YourTal support.

region_not_supported.title: {app} isn't available for your account
region_not_supported.body: Your YourTal account is for a country {app} doesn't support, so you can't use it to sign in to {app}. Nothing from your account was shared.

teen_not_allowed.title: {app} is for people 18 and over
teen_not_allowed.body: Your YourTal account is a teen account, so you can't use it to sign in to {app}. Nothing from your account was shared with {app}.

teen_invite_required.title: You need an invite from your parent
teen_invite_required.body: To use {app} with a teen account, the parent or guardian who approved your YourTal account needs to invite you from their {app} account. Nothing from your account was shared with {app}.

problem.not_approved: Your parent or guardian hasn't approved your YourTal account yet. We've emailed them. Once they approve it, they can invite you to {app}.
problem.wrong_inviter: This invite wasn't made by the parent or guardian who approved your YourTal account. Ask them to send you one.
problem.invite_expired: This invite has expired or has already been used. Ask your parent for a new one.

ended.heading: This sign-in has ended
ended.body: Go back to the app and try again.

unavailable.heading: We couldn't load this sign-in
unavailable.body: Something went wrong on our end. Try again in a moment.
